{{Quote|I sent my team of archaeologists into a jungle catacomb to search for artifacts rumored to be buried there. My team is now missing. Worst of all, I have neither the artifacts nor data from their expedition.|Imperial archaeologist Maheyya to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Forgotten Treasures" />}}
An [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] '''expedition''' was led by the [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Maheyya]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[3627 BBY]] during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. All of Maheyya's research team members became crazed and possessed in the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Ancient Sith crypt|crypt]] she sent them to investigate. Assistance from Imperial heroes assured the recovery of several relics, tablets, and the expedition team's data.

==History==
{{Quote|It's impossible to overstate the potential value of these antiquities. Please, help me recover them and--if you can find them--my people, too.|Imperial archaeologist Maheyya to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Forgotten Treasures" />}}
[[File:OnderonSithCrypt.png|thumb|right|250px|The Imperial archaeological expedition on Onderon was meant to recover valuable artifacts in an ancient Sith crypt (pictured).]]
Shortly after a [[Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)|conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Republic [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Third Galactic War]], Imperial [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Maheyya]] dispatched a research team to an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Ancient Sith crypt|crypt]] on the planet to uncover valuable artifacts. The team members entered the crypt but became crazed and possessed while inside and never returned.<ref name="Forgotten Treasures" />

Maheyya subsequently solicited the assistance of Imperial heroes to enter the crypt and recover the ancient Sith artifacts which included a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] fragment, a ceremonial urn, a [[Sith sword|sword]], a ritual basin, and a holocron. Attempting to seize the holocron provoked an attack by a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]], which the heroes defeated.<ref name="Forgotten Treasures" /> While in the crypt, the heroes also recovered data gathered by the expedition team members<ref name="Recovering the Data" /> and found several [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramic]] and [[Stone/Legends|stone]] Sith tablets believed by archaeologists to have been lost forever.<ref name="Unearthing the Past" /> The heroes successfully returned all these items to Imperial custody.<ref name="Forgotten Treasures" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Oh, my, it's you! Please, if it's not too much to ask... the Empire could greatly benefit from your assistance.|Imperial archaeologist Maheyya to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Forgotten Treasures" />}}
The Imperial Onderon expedition appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|Onslaught]]'', the seventh Digital Expansion to the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Imperial player characters of any class gain access to the Onderon daily missions after completing the expansion's main storyline.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
